race.comment: REGAL MIGHT (2) can go one better in the opener. He's been runner-up in both efforts this time in and the form has worked out behind Prince Tycoon & Mahershala. He puts himself on speed and should be at peak fitness here in a race without a whole lot of pressure. MISS LOLA (10) was well supported at Caulfield in stronger company last start but just battled. Back up to 1200m should suit her much better, her win prior was in strong time. STAR TRIP (5) never got warm first up at Bendigo. We'll say that was inconclusive but still, he could've done more late. He can improve sharply. ELECTRIC ELVIS (4) was dominant in easier last start and goes in based on that effort.
